disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 3 print per-sample and mean ± SD cadmium, nickel and lead for 10 samples each of three chocolates and three candies from Baghdad markets.

study.design: market survey of chocolates and candies consumed by children
study.origin: chocolates made in Germany (1) and Emirates (2); candies made in Iraq (1) and India (2)
study.market: main food distribution networks, supermarkets and markets, Baghdad, Iraq

period.as_reported: January to March 2017 (Methods); January to April 2017 (Abstract)

study.method: ETAAS after HNO3/H2O2 (1:1) microwave digestion, Pd/Mg(NO3)2 modifier
